Benchmark knowledge evidence: born on 1959/2/18 refers to Birthday = '1959-02-18'; calculation = SUBTRACT(SUM(Birthday = '1959-02-18' and Date like '1981-11-%' THEN `T-CHO`), SUM(Birthday = '1959-02-18' and Date like '1981-12-%' THEN `T-CHO`))
